findings.title: Cleanup targets the wrong identity-provider alias
findings.body: This registers cleanup for the literal alias `alias`, not the newly created provider (`idp-alias-*`). The providers created in this test therefore remain in the shared test realm; the same mistake occurs at line 425 for `idp-alias-20`. Later test runs can fail when these fixed aliases already exist, and leftover providers can affect other tests.
